audit: selfid full-budget matrix cost (audit 1 of pre-launch design audit)

method.config: configs/selfid_positive_control_p0_smoke.json (obs72, online_gru, rollout_steps=128, hidden_size=64, recurrent_sequence_training=true) with CLI overrides; privileged twin = configs/selfid_positive_control_privileged_smoke.json
method.throughput_definition: marginal env steps/s = (steps_long - steps_short) / (wall_long - wall_short), wall measured with /usr/bin/time on full subprocess; short run = 1 rollout to absorb import/env-init/final-eval overhead
method.caveat: throughput measured on undertrained (smoke-maturity) policies with ~65-step episodes; converged policies have longer episodes and fewer resets. Assigned +-30% uncertainty (inference, not measured).

measured_training_throughput.label: cuda_ne16
measured_training_throughput.note: CUDA is ~2.6x SLOWER than CPU: per-env-step act() host<->device transfers dominate for a 64-hidden GRU

measured_training_throughput.label: cpu_ne16_singlethread (OMP_NUM_THREADS=1)
measured_training_throughput.note: single thread BEATS default threading (1534 vs 1052) while using 1 core instead of ~7

measured_training_throughput.label: privileged_obs76_ne16_singlethread
measured_training_throughput.note: obs76 twin trains at ~same speed as obs72; overhead proxy taken from p0 short run (inference component)

measured_parallel_scaling.label: 24-32 concurrent
measured_parallel_scaling.status: NOT measured; inferred aggregate ~14000-16000 env steps/s, RAM fits (1.0 GB/job)

measured_eval_throughput.note: smoke policy dies early (~61 steps/ep); converged-policy bound uses max_steps=800 (inference): 300 x 800 / 3882 ~= 62 s per 300-episode eval

measured_gate_chain.scope: hidden_swap_gate on BOTH twins (8 seeds each) + privileged_value_swap probe, smoke checkpoints, single thread
measured_gate_chain.full_budget_extrapolation: inference: with 128 gate seeds and 800-step continuations ~ 2.78 x 16 x 12 ~= 9 min per twin-pair; even per-seed (10 pairs) stays < 2 h total

total_cost_estimates.gpu_note: MEASURED: CUDA is 2.6x slower than CPU for this model; the correct device is cpu. The whole matrix costs ~0 GPU hours.
total_cost_estimates.recommended_plan: 16-32 concurrent single-seed processes, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1, device=cpu, num_envs=16, vector_env_mode=sync; one process per (cell, seed)

reduction_menu.option: stage 1 first: 4 extreme cells (e.g. P1,P3 x T1,T4) + full Exp2 before go/no-go
reduction_menu.warning: pre-registered stop rule forbids outcome-based continuation decisions; staging must be re-registered as execution order with an infrastructure-only interim look, or it violates the design

bottleneck_observation: CPU-bound single-process rollout: Python env stepping + per-step GRU act() dominate; PPO update is a minor share. GPU update never pays off at this model size (CUDA run pinned at 100% of ONE cpu core and 402 sps). Default torch threading actively hurts (809% CPU for 778 sps at ne2 vs 99% CPU for 1534 sps singlethread at ne16). Parallelism across seeds, not within a job, is the win.
launch_blockers_noted_for_other_audits: ObservationDegradationWrapper is NOT wired into train_ppo.py / vector_env.py / evaluate.py: Experiment 1 degraded cells (16 of 20) cannot currently be launched via any config path. Cost numbers transfer (wrapper overhead 4.0%) but this is a NEEDS-FIX before launch.

evaluate.py summary lacks success_rate and clearance_margin_p10; per-episode rows carry outcome_bucket and min_clearance_margin so a post-hoc analysis script suffices (no rerun needed), but it must exist before launch.
full-budget config must freeze num_envs (smoke config says 2; this audit's throughput recommendation is 16) BEFORE launch since the design requires identical env count across cells.
